'''April 2000 Milwaukee tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Milwaukee, WI on 29 April 2000. It is known from Ryan Fojtik's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d671">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-05-milwaukee-wi-4-29-00d671/ milwaukee-wi-4-29-00], DeckTech (Ryan "XjedeyeX" Fojtik, 5 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-05-milwaukee-wi-4-29-00d671/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Milwaukee, WI
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
